help_body:
AI Crew adds immersion through remarks from captains and pilots. Crew members with names and personalities are assigned to the units you select and deliver short reports or impressions based on the current situation through pop-up notifications.

### Getting started with AI Crew

1. **Choose an API connection**  
   Choose a connection in **Settings > API connections** and save. Connections registered in AI Advisor are also available.

2. **Choose participating units**  
   Select units under **Reporting units** and press **Apply**. Use **All ON** to select everyone together.

3. **Receive reports**  
   Names and personalities are generated automatically. Remarks appear as on-screen notifications and can also be read in **Report history**.

### Things to know

- Only current formation leaders and standalone units speak.
- Not everyone speaks on every occasion.
- Adjust the interval and notification position in **Settings > Reports**.
- Closing this window or pausing the game does not stop API requests. To stop them, press **Pause** in **Report history**.
- Crew identities, unit selections and report history are not stored in saved games.
- AI-generated remarks may contain information that differs from the actual situation.
- To hide this tab, turn off **Show Getting started tab** in **Settings > Reports** and save.

Future development may include letting crew members control units.
connection_hint: Registered connections are shared with AI Advisor. Reports selects its own connection. Editing a connection affects every feature using it.
interval_hint: The interval applies to AI Crew as a whole, in real time even while paused. Timing varies and crew members may remain silent.
targets_hint: Choose units and press Apply to generate names and personalities together. Only current formation leaders and standalone units report. Crew and ON/OFF selections stay with each unit when formations change.
empty_history: No reports yet. Choose a connection in Settings, then enable reporting units.
error.connection_required: Choose a Reports connection before enabling a unit.
error.connection_missing: The selected connection no longer exists. Choose another connection in Settings.
error.provider_unavailable: This connection adapter does not support Reports.
error.settings_invalid: Check the interval (1-15 minutes), exchange preference (0-100%), and notification settings.
error.invalid_response: The AI returned an invalid report.
error.too_large: The report input is too large.
error.unexpected_error: Reports encountered an error. See the log for details.
exchange_chance_hint: Applies when multiple speakers are eligible. Even at 100%, independent remarks or silence are possible.
